Subject: Post-call: Security & procurement checklist for Medinex pilot

Thanks again for taking time today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Summary (from today)
- Pilot scope: ML-assisted triage on outpatient intake (pilot, non-PHI dataset).
- Key contacts: Lydia (security), Ryan (procurement / econ buyer), Legal TBD.

What Redwood will provide
- SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) and access to full report under NDA.
- Redacted pen-test results on secure link.
- Audit logs: default retention 90 days; we can provision 365 days for pilot (small fee) — details below.

Requests from Medinex
1) Security: access to SOC 2 artifacts and a redacted pen-test PDF for review.
2) Procurement: outline PO & SOW cadence; initial PO expected before pilot start.
3) Legal: DPA + any custom clauses flagged by your counsel.

Proposed timeline
- This week: Medinex sends procurement path + list of legal reviewers.
- By 2028-04-25: Redwood uploads SOC2 full report to secure link (requires NDA).
- By 2028-05-08: Medinex confirms PO timeline and pilot kickoff date (target go-live: 2028-06-01).

Attachments:
- Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

Immediate asks (can you confirm over email):
- Lydia: does Medinex need the unredacted pen-test under NDA or is a redacted version sufficient for initial review?
- Ryan: who owns the PO process and expected PO submission date?
\If it helps I can draft a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and route it to Ryan + legal.
\Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Thanks, Stephanie — good notes. Quick answers from security + procurement perspective: 

Security (from our team)
- SOC2 Type II: we require the report and the auditor opinion. We'll sign an NDA for full report access.
- Pen test: redacted PDF is fine for initial review; our InfoSec lead may request a scoped unredacted if we get to contract stage.
- Audit logs / retention: we need confirmation that audit logs can be retained for 365 days and exported on request (immutable export). Can you confirm the export format and whether there is an archival SLA?
- Encryption & key management: Provide short notes on KMS integration (is BYOK possible?).

Procurement / Buying committee
- Econ buyer: Ryan Patel (cc'd). Ryan will loop in legal and procurement distribution lists after we confirm sample artifacts.
- PO timing: target is to have PO in place 2–3 weeks after artifacts are accepted. We'll confirm exact date once legal reviews SOC2/DPA.

\I've attached our initial security questionnaire with a few clarifying items — mostly around retention, access controls, and pen-test handling.
\Attachments:
- medinex-internal-security-questions.pdf (attachment stub)
\Lydia Morales
Sr. Director, InfoSec
Medinex Health

Appreciate the fast reply, Lydia — answers below and next steps spelled out.
\Answers / commitments from Redwood
- SOC2: We will share the SOC 2 Type II report and auditor opinion via a secure Drive link once your NDA is in place. (Link will be provided by 2028-04-25).
- Pen test: We will provide a redacted pen-test PDF in this thread (see attachment) and can provide an unredacted copy under stricter controls if requested during contracting.
- Audit logs & retention: We support 365-day retention for pilot customers. Exports available in NDJSON/CSV with an immutable export option; archival SLA: 7 days to produce a certified export. There may be a small monthly storage uplift for >90 days — I'll include numbers in the MAP.
- KMS / BYOK: BYOK is available for Private deployments; for hosted pilots we offer customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS integrations) with HSM-backed encryption for keys at rest.

Deliverables & timeline (proposed)\- 2028-04-20: Redwood to upload redacted pen-test and provide secure SOC2 link (requires NDA).
- 2028-04-22: Medinex to indicate legal reviewer + confirm whether redacted pen-test suffices.
- 2028-04-29: MAP shared by Redwood + cost uplift for 365-day retention.

Attachments / links:
- redwood-pen-test-redacted.zip (attachment stub)
- SOC2 link: https://drive.google.com/secure-link/redwood/soc2-summary
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-9347-MDX
